input.content:
Prepare the billing statement for CUS-004 at Beacon.
Source documents: beacon-billing-04.csv and beacon-billing-terms-04.csv.
Invoice amount = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_rate) * (1 + tax_rate) + shipping. Use the values in the terms table. Round monetary amounts to two decimal places using half-even rounding. Deliver JSON with record_id and amount.
Provide a delivery summary when finished.
